cards.title: TOWN SCRIBE
cards.concept: neat town scribe in a plain grey linen shirt and dark waistcoat, holding a quill and a half-unrolled parchment scroll at his chest, calm assured smile.
cards.hook: Chief Legal Officer: every great deal starts as a carefully drafted document.

cards.title: INNKEEPER
cards.concept: welcoming innkeeper in a grey apron over a crisp white shirt, a brass key ring raised beside his face and a warm lantern glowing behind his shoulder.
cards.hook: Hospitality is one of the industries where he led financings and restructurings.

cards.title: MONEYCHANGER
cards.concept: market moneychanger in a grey wool coat with a small brass balance scale of stacked coins held at his chest and a pencil tucked behind his ear.
cards.hook: Finance leadership: the man who knows exactly what every coin is worth.

cards.title: CARD DEALER
cards.concept: poised gaming-hall dealer in a silver-grey vest, white shirt and black bow tie, fanning a hand of playing cards at his chest with a steady poker smile.
cards.hook: Gaming is one of his industries, and a trustworthy dealer keeps every table fair.

cards.title: LAW APPRENTICE
cards.concept: bright-eyed law apprentice in a simple grey scholar's robe, hugging a tall stack of leather-bound law books to his chest, side-parted hair neat.
cards.hook: JD/MBA from UCLA: the long nights of study behind the counsel.

cards.title: DEAL BROKER
cards.concept: guild deal broker in a tailored leather doublet with green trim, holding up a contract sealed with green wax and a clinking coin purse, confident half-smile.
cards.hook: Led M&A across tech, gaming and hospitality: two parties, one signature.

cards.title: WILDCAT RANGER
cards.concept: desert ranger in a sand-coloured cloak and green scarf, a short bow slung behind his back and a bronze wildcat-paw clasp pinning the cloak at his chest.
cards.hook: BS from Arizona: a proud Arizona Wildcat.

cards.title: ROYAL HERALD
cards.concept: royal herald in a green-and-grey tabard, a brass horn with a small green banner over one shoulder and an official decree scroll held at his chest.
cards.hook: General counsel speaks for the company: every official word goes through him.

cards.title: BRUIN SQUIRE
cards.concept: young squire in a quilted gambeson with green trim and a round wooden shield on his back, a friendly bear cub familiar clinging to his shoulder.
cards.hook: UCLA Bruins: JD and MBA, the bear cub that grew into a knight.

cards.title: PALADIN OF LAW
cards.concept: bareheaded paladin in polished silver plate with a teal tabard, holding a shield shaped like an open law book whose pages glow faint teal.
cards.hook: Chief Legal Officer: the company's shield.

cards.title: ROYAL TREASURER
cards.concept: royal treasurer in a high-collared dark robe with teal embroidery, holding a teal-bound ledger to his chest and a heavy ornate vault key over his shoulder, faint teal glow on the key.
cards.hook: Finance leadership and $1B+ in financings: keeper of the crown's treasury.

cards.title: GRANDMASTER
cards.concept: calm strategist in a sleek teal-lined tactician's coat, holding a glowing teal chess king at his chest while faint chessboard lines shimmer behind his head.
cards.hook: Restructurings and business transformation: always thinking ten moves ahead.

cards.title: HIGH JUSTICAR
cards.concept: noble high justicar in an ornate violet mantle and silver gorget, raising glowing violet scales of justice beside his face, a faint violet glint in his eyes with pupils still visible, swirling magenta runes behind him.
cards.hook: Legal leadership: the fair and final judgement in every dispute.

cards.title: VAULT WARDEN
cards.concept: bareheaded vault warden in dark ornate plate with violet filigree, neat side-parted hair visible, head-and-shoulders framing with a colossal round vault door blazing with violet runes behind him and a few violet-lit coins glinting at his shoulder.
cards.hook: Led $1B+ in financing: guardian of a billion-coin vault.

cards.title: ARBITER OF STARS
cards.concept: celestial arbiter in radiant gold-and-white regalia with a slim gold circlet that leaves his side-parted hair visible, holding a glowing golden covenant scroll at his chest, calm smile, a blazing halo behind his head with a faint star-sword shape inside it.
cards.hook: The final word on every deal: the covenant-maker whose contracts bind whole realms.
